title: Wishlist
surface: The tab's count goes up when you save, so the page looks right until you open the list and it is empty.
task: Save the fountain pen and the notebook to your wishlist, then open the wishlist to check they are there.

plantedBug.what: The wishlist tab badge counts saved items correctly, but the tab itself always shows the 'No saved items yet.' empty state: saved products are lost.
